auditoria.erro: mechanism: the library only adds vector types, distances and HNSW/IVFFlat indexes; hybrid RRF, embeddings and cross-encoder reranking live in linked example scripts using other libraries, not in pgvector-python.

final.role: Python client library for pgvector (Django, SQLAlchemy, Psycopg, asyncpg), with hybrid search examples; requires PostgreSQL.
final.evidence: pgvector support for Python; vector fields, L2/cosine distances, HnswIndex/IvfflatIndex; hybrid search (RRF, cross-encoder) only as linked examples.

auditoria.nota: Só serve se o hub adotar PostgreSQL com pgvector como índice; é cola Python, não um mecanismo de busca.
